purpose: Per-connection explanations and direct evidence links for controller-centered retrofit wiring panels. Edge indices are zero-based and refer to retrofit-guides.json as read for this artifact.

coverage.coverage_rule: Exactly one record for every edge in every wire panel of the four assigned profiles. Sources state the exact supported fact and qualification states the remaining machine/revision boundary.

mill-g2.selected_architecture: Replace the PROVer V2 controller with V2 Prime integrated drivers connected directly to X/Y/Z motor phase leads. The source identifies the factory controller as a single GRBL board with onboard TB67S109 drivers; it does not identify separate external stepper-driver boxes. Do not select the Core + DM320T external-driver route as the main conversion for this profile.

decision_sources.title: Genmitsu 3018-PROVer V2 User Manual V1.0 (2022-09-06), English p.3 specification; pp.16–20 machine/control-board cabling and peripheral schedule
decision_sources.claim: p.3 identifies the model, GRBL1.1h control compatibility and TB67S109 driver; p.16 shows 4-wire axis motor and 3-wire limit cable sockets to the control board; pp.19–20 name factory machine interfaces. This evidence supports integrated original drivers and direct Prime phase-output replacement as an architecture choice, not an installed harness pinout.

decision_sources.title: Smoothieboard2 V2 Prime P12 2590 exact motor-output schematic at pinned source revision
decision_sources.claim: P12 schematic identifies four integrated motor driver channels and their A/B phase outputs at J5–J8. This establishes board-side phase connections; it does not prove installed motor harness cavity order or current compatibility.

hardware_inventory.evidence: V1.0 English p.3 lists TB67S109; p.16 depicts axis motors plugged into the control board.
hardware_inventory.retrofit_implication: Use Prime integrated phase outputs directly to each identified four-wire motor coil pair. Remove or disconnect the old controller driver outputs; do not insert external DM320T drivers in the selected diagram.
